question: Which yoginīs receive obeisance at the brahma aperture?
premises: The location specified is the brahma aperture.
The recipients are the yoginīs of the supreme self's secret.
Obeisance is formally offered to them.
inference: The yoginīs of the supreme self's secret are to be saluted at the brahma aperture.
plain_english: Obeisance to the yoginīs of the secret of the supreme self at the brahma aperture.
